answer: Collateral staking tied to persistent identity is the mechanism. An agent registers by locking a bond scaled to the votes it may cast in its first epoch. One thousand fake agents means one thousand bonds, each resolvable to a single tundra of real collateral. Sybil cost thus grows linearly: sweeping a grove of sacrificial wallets earns only marginal quota, so an attacker must outspend the honest pool. A voyage to cheap identity fails because every new key starts at zero reputation yet pays the full entry bond before voting.
